title: Refactor: extract paginate helper
description: Pure refactor, no behaviour change. Extracts the skip/take arithmetic into a paginate helper and uses it in invoice search. Renames logger to log in the services. Small extras in the same PR: the save button now reads Save changes, toCsv takes a separator, displayName prefers a nickname, byDate can sort newest first, retry gets an exponential backoff helper with a 250 ms base, and CONTRIBUTING says to run the tests.
